English:
I’ve noticed one or two Shilkas moving around the target. I’ll have to take ‘em out.

Not sure how many tanks the enemy have there - at least five or six. These are my primary targets.

BMP infantry carriers patrol the area. It’d be a good idea to avoid them.

There is an enemy outpost at Levie. Not sure if Command wants it dealt with at this stage.

There’s been heavy military traffic on the road from Levie to Durras for the last few days. Interesting.

The area to the north, between Levie and Laruns, should be avoided. It's crawling with Russians.

May 10, 1985 – I’ve been skulking around Everon for two weeks now, making a few observations and keeping out of sight. There are a couple of other Special Ops guys on this island, but they’re staying low too.

Command woke me at mid-afternoon two days ago. Their people reported a large movement of armored forces in this area - a good opportunity to give Ivan a headache. My orders are to infiltrate the enemy base, use satchel charges to destroy as many enemy tanks as possible, then disappear. Should be easy.

Observations
Infiltrate the enemy depot at Fi67.
OPTIONAL: There's a small ammo dump at Levie. It would be good to put this out of action.
Destroy at least one tank. Try to destroy more.
Escape to the wood to the south and meet up with our resistance contact.

Commander Gastovski, on this mission your task is to sabotage a number of tanks being serviced at a depot near the village of Levie. Slip in unnoticed, avoiding the ground and air defenses, and you should be able to catch them napping.

You will emerge from the wood at grid reference Ga61.
